title: Glowstone Prism UI
description: A minimal UI pack. Meant to be paired with an invisible inventory RP.
body:
This RP was made with MCreator's built in Resource Pack maker and editor.

This RP aims to be as minimal as possible.
FEATURES
- All hearts
- Hunger
- Hotbar
- Bubbles
- (basically all main HUD)

NOTICE
This does **not** support the inventory. This resource pack is meant to be paired with an invisible inventory pack. I do not plan to add support for the inventory.
